blockers.rationale: A timed-out Docker verification returned TIMED_OUT while its container appeared after the cleanup absence check and remained in Created state. Stable cleanup cannot be guaranteed until daemon-side creation/removal is synchronized and stress-tested.
blockers.smallestRemediation: Make container lifecycle ownership explicit: create then inspect before start, or otherwise wait for the Docker client/daemon operation to settle; remove by the exact random name until confirmed absent after the creation process has terminated; add repeated timeout-race regression coverage. Preserve network denial, non-root, read-only rootfs, resource limits and no local fallback.

blockers.rationale: No package exports map defines whether deep dist imports are supported, so v1 semantic-version obligations would be ambiguous.
blockers.smallestRemediation: Choose and test one explicit boundary: CLI-only, or a deliberately enumerated supported programmatic API. Add an exports map and a release note; do not expose implementation modules accidentally.

blockers.rationale: Stable scan/report/MCP surfaces and experimental auth-graph/host-integration/diagnostic surfaces are shipped together without a public v1 compatibility policy.
blockers.smallestRemediation: Publish a reviewed stability table and evolution rules for CLI flags/exit codes, JSON schemas, SARIF extensions, rule IDs/versions, MCP schemas, configuration and experimental surfaces. No implementation expansion is required.

blockers.rationale: Primary documentation tells users to install older Alpha releases and incorrectly describes Beta.3 as unpublished and hosted/provenance evidence as absent.
blockers.smallestRemediation: Correct the README, claims, limitations and agent/install pages to the immutable Beta.3 evidence; document unambiguous exact-version npm exec syntax and retain all honest coverage limits.
